payload.activities: Community run. Distance and pace details: confirm with the organiser.
payload.purpose: A fitness and wellness event combining a community run, cold water therapy and heat recovery.
payload.offerTerms: Check the Eventbrite listing for the latest participation and recovery-session details.
payload.arrival: Arrival from 07:10. Free parking is listed by the organiser. Ages 16 and over.
payload.itinerary:
07:10 — Arrival
07:30 — Event begins
Community run followed by cold plunge and sauna
12:00 — Event ends

payload.cancellationPolicy: URC reservations will open here once the booking service is connected. For a booking already made on Eventbrite, use that booking’s confirmation and instructions.

Free run
Free run + cold plunge
Free run + cold plunge + sauna
